name: Virtual Human Platform
what: The VHP4Safety portal: a single entry point to the chemical safety assessment services the consortium runs.

name: AOP-Wiki RDF
what: Converts the AOP-Wiki to RDF, versions every release as its own named graph, and serves it over a public SPARQL endpoint with a query interface and dashboard.

name: molAOP Builder and Analyser
what: Maps Adverse Outcome Pathway key events onto molecular pathways, and analyses the resulting molecular AOPs.

name: ToxTempAssistant
what: ToxTempAssistant helps scientists document cell-based toxicological test methods more efficiently.
